name: smwgraphics-sonic-the-hedgehog-green-hill-zone-totems
title: Sonic the Hedgehog - Green Hill Zone (Totems)
description:
Custom SMW style conversions for the totems seen in Green Hill Zone from Sonic The Hedgehog for the foreground version and Sonic Mania for the giant totems background version.

The foreground tiles do not use custom palette, it works better with the normal grassland colors.
